title: Three Stars
text:
Three Stars. Amazing value, but the roller is too short. I need to find out how to get one that fits.

This is a great quality roller, but take the time to turn your vacuum upside down and measure the roller brush. This brush is 11 1/4" long. My vac is XL Susan Komen. But the 11 1/4" XL brush doesn't work on it. I need the 12/1/4" XL21 brush. Check before you buy.

product_metadata.title: For ORECK XL Vacuums BEST Roller (BRUSH ROLL + 6 BELTS)
features: Fiberglass filled construction, metal pulley and heavy duty bearings make these Brush Rolls virtually indestructible
Shipped by Priority Mail - you will get it fast!!!
Two mounting positions allow adjusting the Roll, as the bristles wear down, to double the effective lifetime of the roller
description: DOES NOT FIT Oreck Commercial Upright XL2100 series. (which is longer) Replacement roller brush compatible with MOST models including 2000, 4000, 9000 and 3000 series XL Upright Vacuum Cleaners.
